description: The NTP packet header consists of an integral number of 32-bit (4 octet) words in network byte order.
note: The message is identified by the Mode field. Modes 1 to 5 share the header of Figure 8 and each has a message file with the same fields. Extension fields (section 7.5) and the message authentication code that may follow the header are variable in number and length and are not transcribed.
